detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Feed the Forest is an active incremental game with satisfying exponential growth, hundreds of upgrades, and absurd satire of idiot trillionaires. Start simple and plant innocent bushes at snail speeds. Then spend the juice you collect to mutate your forest into an ungodly abomination of pure value production. 

Spread life in the desert!

Become an unstoppable growth machine!

Upgrade your snail!

Automate and optimize!

Features

  • Over 100 upgrades (Over 1000 if you count buying the same multiple times…)

  • A wide collection of different snail skins to collect

  • Multiple resources to balance and optimize for, like Juice, Rot, Gasoline and… Blood?

  • [REDACTED] amount of different plant and helper snail types (it’s secret)

  • Bombing your forest to make it produce more

  • Rolling D20s to get golden fruits and jackpots

  • Beautiful storybook illustrations and a nice little story about the horrors of infinite growth

  • Circular financing, high-impact KPIs, and disruptive returns on capex

Is this game for you?

Feed the Forest is for you if you:

Want a relaxing and chill game

  • A chill incremental experience focused on gradual, smooth growth and progression

Want an extremely satisfying experience

  • Every mechanic you unlock makes the game more satisfying: Paint every corner of the desert green, merge plants into greater plants, automate fruit collection with minions, roll dice to get jackpots and fill your forest with more and more valuable plants

Enjoy light optimization challenges

  • Balance the composition and layout of different plants in order to create the most optimal synergies 

Delight in absurd settings

  • A naive little snail who just wants to have an adventure and make mad stacks, but gets corrupted by a mysterious sand-worm-creature. Together they create a decadent and absurd forest of untold horrors.

Like creative, expressive gameplay

  • Paint the desert with a variety of colorful “plant-brushes” to create the forest that you prefer. Upgrade your reach to plant faster or tweak details with precision painting

Three devs

Hi! We're Victor, Andrés and Edd! This game started as just a game jam game, but over ten thousand people played it in the first week, which blew our minds. So we decided to make it bigger and bloodier better! 

We can only make it great with a bunch of player feedback, so please follow this page to hear about updates, or join our Discord in the sidebar to get notified!
